tuning.scope: Separate diagnostic worker including communicator setup and warmed workload calls. Counts are log records, not scoped invocation counts. No event-to-collective or operator-group join is claimed.
tuning.interpretation: Kernel entry names do not identify the selected algorithm/protocol. These are actual NCCL tuning log decisions; payload-size matches alone do not establish per-group identity.

unavailable_fields.communication_wire_time_ms: All 8 kernels are ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL and their durations include device waiting (sequence 19: 17,961.288us on rank 0 vs 11.105us on rank 1 for the identical 6,144B payload); nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer, so wire time stays unknown.
unavailable_fields.exposed_communication_critical_path_ms: compute_overlap_ms (11.218/12.407ms) and communication_without_compute_ms (44.641/23.808ms) are interval overlaps local to one trace clock; uncovered communication is not a measured critical path or causal speedup.
unavailable_fields.exact_event_to_bucket_identity: Passive inventory reports a single bucket (index 0, 124,439,808 elements, 497,759,232 logical bytes) against 8 timed collectives; bucket_attribution is payload-compatible candidates only. Exact links require native correlation plus observed gradient-storage membership; until nsys/execution_timeline evidence supplies them, candidates remain ambiguous.
unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; topology and logical payload do not measure traffic. NVML exposes only device-wide rates (probe read 1,708/390 and 341/488 KB/s outside the workload) with ~20ms native windows, not per-collective bytes.
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3 on both devices (nvlink not_supported); hardware counters unavailable and the 497,759,232B logical per-rank payload must not be converted into NVLink traffic.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; device-wide NVML utilization periods are not aligned to operator ranges (probe read 0.0 percent outside the workload).
unavailable_fields.per_collective_pcie_traffic_bytes: device_telemetry samples device-wide NVML rates with native sampling windows; it cannot attribute bytes to any of the 8 collectives, so this dimension is not requested from it.
unavailable_fields.host_dispatch_clean_ms: No actual collector supplies a clean host dispatch score: python_runtime perturbs execution and its cProfile inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations; current trace evidence does not isolate a host-dispatch question, so it is not selected.
unavailable_fields.successful_path_identification: candidate_diagnostics records exceptions (including handled ones) and False returns only and no candidate files are supplied in this run; empty events would not establish which successful path executed.
unavailable_fields.first_numerical_divergence_site: No actual collector compares intermediate tensors, measures per-site numerical error, or locates the first numerical divergence; these observations remain unavailable.

collection_plan.rationale: torch already ran and fully observed the required communication_kernel_sum_ms (8/8 allreduce collectives per rank: 6,144B + 6x56,702,976B + 157,535,232B f32 SUM, 497,759,232B logical per rank; per-rank sums 55.859ms/36.215ms, max across ranks then median over repeats), so it is not re-selected. The frozen objective (minimize max-rank clean step_ms with the 1.05x original-baseline constraint; NCCL kernel sum only a separately profiled diagnostic) leaves four evidence-grounded open questions. (1) Wait vs structure: the 6,144B collective took 17,961us on rank 0 vs 11us on rank 1 and identical 56,702,976B payloads vary 4.07-5.57ms, so durations are wait-dominated and arrival-skewed; nsys (probe status available, runs separately from clean timing) is selected to resolve the overlap/attribution question - stream structure, NCCL spans vs compute intervals, launch rows for the 8 collectives - while accepting that nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer or prove bucket identity. (2) Protocol: every kernel entry reads ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL and the NCCL logs only establish 2 SHM/direct/direct channels, ring PXN 0 GDR 1, NVLS multicast unavailable (NVLS_NCHANNELS 0) and network Socket; kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol, so nccl_tuning is selected to capture the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions made in its separate warmed worker at the observed sizes. (3) Reference behavior: collective_calibration is selected to run its synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at the actually observed sizes/dtypes (6,144B; 56,702,976B; 157,535,232B; Float; world 2) with correctness checks, as a reference experiment for interpreting the 4-5.5ms and 10.5ms kernel durations - not a performance lower bound, wire time or model critical-path estimate, and it does not join payload matches to operator groups.
